description: A brand's angles: the pitch each ad leans on, for whom; offers sit on top. Each angle has a type (problem/solution, proof, founder story…), a short name for the idea, the newest headline hook, the persona it speaks to (a segment nickname, the buyer's situation in their words, an age range when the ad shows one, and awareness stage from unaware to most-aware), the product, how many ads (and live ads) and landing pages use it, when it was first and last seen, and the offers the same ads carried. Most used first. Use it to answer 'how does this brand sell' or to compare two brands' messaging. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_angles
title: Find a brand's angles
